digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration - Bedrock parity measurement
propositions: Bedrock inference-profile ids are invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 on both standard (sonnet) and frontier (opus) slots.
Outbound request payloads are byte-equivalent across Bedrock and direct Anthropic providers for identical logical calls, with only the model id differing and eight documented envelope differences.
Tool sets offered to the model are identical across providers: 6 tools with matching names, descriptions and input schemas on both Bedrock and Anthropic.
Provider routing is clean: zero non-Bedrock calls recorded across all Bedrock-configured case-runs via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally.
Temperature capability difference is symmetric and explicit: temperature=0.0 is withdrawn from opus on both providers and sent to sonnet on both, driven by model-level supports_temperature override.
Corpus pooling across 15 specs yields 30 gold items (15 block, 15 advisory), clearing MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20 floor with no lowering of the minimum.
